ITEM 1 | Pale white-cream rice with soft, slightly clumped grains and a moist, matte surface, mounded in an irregular heap about 7 cm across and 1.5 cm high, sitting on the lower-left of the plate | 130
ITEM 2 | Crisp-looking green leafy greens, bright to mid green with darker edges and ruffled curly leaves, scattered in a loose cluster about 10 cm long and 1 cm thick, sitting left of the fish and above the rice | 25
ITEM 3 | Pale golden-cream fish fillet, flaky and moist with visible fibrous layers, roughly 9 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm thick, with a glossy sheen, topped with small brown lentil-like pieces and a few brown granules scattered over it | 150
ITEM 4 | Small brown lentil-like pieces scattered over and around the fish, dull brown and firm, about 0.5 cm each, roughly a dozen pieces | 8
ITEM 5 | Two roasted potato wedges, golden-brown with browned crisp edges and soft pale interior, each about 5 cm long and 3 cm wide, sitting at the lower-right of the fish | 90
ITEM 6 | Two or three pecan-like nut halves, reddish-brown with ridged shell-like texture and a slightly glossy coating, about 2.5 cm each, sitting beside the potato wedges | 12
